about.what: Diagnostics file from smc3_scope, the page server for a DIY 3-motor SMC3 motion seat: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi running SMC3_R4 firmware, IBT-2 / BTS7960 motor bridges, DC motors with feedback pots, driven by SimHub over USB. smc3_scope runs on a NAS and talks to the board over WiFi. Made to be read by a person or an AI (such as Claude) helping to find what is wrong.
about.read_first: 'problem' is what the owner typed. 'summary' and 'findings' are the page's own conclusions; everything after them is the measured data behind them. 'check' exists only for a full check (each motor moved a little).

units.positions: 0-1023 SMC3 counts (the pot reading scaled), 512 = middle of travel.
units.t, g, f, p in traces: t = target as commanded (SimHub or this page), g = goal (target after the firmware's smoothing filter - what the PID chases), f = feedback (pot), p = PID output in PWM units -255..255 before PWMmin is added; positive p drives towards higher counts.
units.Kp, Ki, Kd: SMC3Utils raw numbers (100 x the original gains). Ks = derivative sample spacing in PID cycles.
units.Max limit (cutoff): counts from each end of the pot range where the safety cutoff switches the motor off.
units.Clip: counts from each end that bound the usable target window; PWMrev pushes back if the pot is outside.
units.Dead zone: counts; inside it the motor brakes instead of driving.
units.roll, pitch: seat angles in degrees from the WT901C motion sensor (firmware 1.8), levelled with 'Level now' and turned to how the sensor is mounted; empty when the sensor sends nothing.

about.traces: CSV text: header in 'columns', one row per sample at 'rate_hz'. off = three 0/1 flags (motors 1-3 switched off), low = 1 when the board runs at quarter power (no position commands for 15 s). roll / pitch columns appear when the motion sensor sends; the sensor may update slower than 100 Hz, so values repeat in between.
about.load_map: watch.last_60_min.motors[].load_map: while SimHub drives, per position band of the Clip window and per direction (towards higher / lower counts): seconds spent moving, mean lag behind the goal (counts, positive = behind), and % of that time at full allowed power - plus the seat angle there. Lifting a heavy load shows as one direction lagging and at full power while the other keeps up.
about.sensor: board.sensor (firmware 1.8): the WT901C on the board's Serial1 - switched on, receiving, baud found, angles per second, tilt limit and trips, level offsets, raw angles. check[].step.*.seat: the seat's own response to each step - degrees moved, degrees per count, overshoot and ringing next to the motor's, lag, and play (counts the motor turns before the seat follows).
about.wiring (firmware defaults): motor n: PWM on D9/D10/D11, bridge enable pins D2+D3 / D4+D5 / D6+D7, pots on A0/A1/A2. MODE2 = IBT-2 bridges. Motion sensor (optional): WT901C-232 TX -> MAX3232 -> D0, D1 -> MAX3232 -> sensor RX, 5 V.

problem: The right motor slams to the end as soon as SimHub starts, and the rear one jerks now and then.
summary:
SMC3 R4 diagnostics - 2026-10-27 11:31:13 (full check, smc3_scope 1.9)
Problem described: The right motor slams to the end as soon as SimHub starts, and the rear one jerks now and then.
Board smc3-r4:4211, firmware 1.8, running 4 min, last start: power-on (the supply was off or dipped low enough to restart it), power low (no position commands for 15 s)
Motors in use: 3 (1 = Left, 2 = Right, 3 = Rear)

[PROBLEM] Motor 2 (Right) moves the WRONG way
    Motor 2 (Right) moved the WRONG way: driven towards higher numbers, its pot went from 521 to 510. With its pot it pushes away from where it should go, so in normal use it runs to the end until the safety cutoff stops it.
    What to do: Swap the two motor wires on motor 2 (Right)'s IBT-2 (M+ and M-). Don't swap the pot as well - that would reverse it again. (If the seat then moves the wrong way in games, invert that axis in SimHub.) The motor was switched off for safety - press Enable Motors after the fix.
[PROBLEM] Motor 3 (Rear)'s pot reading jumps (glitches)
    Readings that change faster than any motor can move: 836 counted by the board, 300 big jumps seen in the live data. This is the classic cause of sudden violent jerks: for a moment the controller thinks the motor is somewhere else and drives hard.
    What to do: The pot wiper is losing contact: a worn or dirty pot, or a loose connector / crimp on the wire to A2. Re-seat the connectors; if it continues, replace the pot (a sealed or contactless one lasts longer).

[WARNING] Play in motor 3 (Rear)'s linkage: it turns 30 counts before the seat follows
    About 0.50° of the seat's movement is lost each time the motor changes direction - small, quick movements (road texture) disappear and direction changes clunk.
    What to do: Check rod ends and ball joints, the lever on the motor shaft (set screw, key) and worn bushings.

[NOTE] Board running for 4 min; it last started because of: power-on (the supply was off or dipped low enough to restart it)
[NOTE] SimHub is not sending positions to the board right now
    No position command has come over USB for a long time, so the board runs at quarter power. Normal when SimHub's motion output is stopped.
    What to do: If SimHub IS running a game: in SimHub, Motion -> Output, the SMC3 device must be on this board's COM port and started. Only one program can use the COM port - close SMC3Utils and the Arduino serial monitor.
[NOTE] Seat movement in the last hour: roll -0.1° to +1.1°, pitch -1.9° to +0.9°
    Fastest movement 80°/s.
[NOTE] Where the motors are
    motor 1 (Left) = left side, motor 3 (Rear) = rear.
[NOTE] Motor 1 (Left) tilts the seat 0.021° per count (roll and pitch)
    A 50-count step moved the seat 1.10°. Over its whole Clip window that is about ±8.7°.
[NOTE] Motor 3 (Rear) tilts the seat 0.017° per count (pitch)
    A 50-count step moved the seat 0.82°. Over its whole Clip window that is about ±6.8°.

[OK] WiFi signal -58 dBm, telemetry 81/s, command round trip 5 ms
[OK] Running settings match what is saved in EEPROM
[OK] Motion sensor: 100 angles per second at 115200 baud
[OK] Every motor checked goes UP for higher numbers
[OK] Motor 1 (Left)'s pot is quiet at rest (±0.35 counts)
[OK] Motor 1 (Left) moves the right way in both directions
[OK] Motor 2 (Right)'s pot is quiet at rest (±0.31 counts)
[OK] Motor 3 (Rear)'s pot is quiet at rest (±0.39 counts)
[OK] Motor 3 (Rear) moves the right way in both directions

Settings running now:
  motor 1: Kp 250, Ki 0, Kd 0, Ks 1, PWMmin 30, PWMmax 100, Max limit (cutoff) 23, Clip 100, Dead zone 2, PWMrev 200
  motor 2: Kp 250, Ki 0, Kd 0, Ks 1, PWMmin 30, PWMmax 100, Max limit (cutoff) 23, Clip 100, Dead zone 2, PWMrev 200
  motor 3: Kp 250, Ki 0, Kd 0, Ks 1, PWMmin 30, PWMmax 100, Max limit (cutoff) 23, Clip 100, Dead zone 2, PWMrev 200
